title: Event editor: a grouped native form in a popover beside the event
steps: With -UseFakeData -UseFakeCalendar open Calendar (2) in Week view; click one of your own events, then a free slot
Read the form top to bottom, then press Tab through it; hover the labels and buttons
Type a whole date into Ends (for example tomorrow) and press Command-Return without leaving the field; open the event again
Repeat in dark appearance, with the window narrow, and in the Mail sidebar's Create event
expected: The card opens beside the event with an arrow, or at the far edge, never over the month, Today or the toolbar. Title; Starts and Ends with the length, time zone, repeat; guests with avatars and answers, Meet; location and notes; then a quieter group (calendar, alert, show as, visibility, colour). No steppers; All-day and Meet are switches; Cancel and Save bottom right. The typed date is kept.
